notes.title: Os Version - 1.7
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone! 

I hope you're all doing well...[/b]

I have been paying attention to all of you who posted feedback, it is much appreciated. I noticed the most common request was "CONTENT". So with that in mind, you now have the following;

- In-game currency system implemented.
- New banking app now downloadable to your in-game desktop.
- New animated xxx artwork added to desktop. (linked to purchasable app)
- New voiced lines added. 
- 2 new wallpapers added (purchasable with new currency system)
- New desktop app added (purchasable with new currency system) 
- Resetting your desktop now requires confirmation. (stop accidental resets)
- Casual difficulty tweaked - Easier.
- UI scaling adjustments (fixing unreadable text while in 4k)


[b]More Detail -[/b]

This new update was designed to fully integrate the desktop with the shoot'em'up. For each threat you destroy in the Hack-Her shoot'em'up, you will steal/earn 1 Gc (Greather coin). You can then spend your coins on in-game desktop content. 

[b]What's Next -[/b]

The next update, which is already well underway, will expand on the currency system, adding even more content for you to purchase. In addition to this, more variation and options are being looked at for the hack-her shoot'em'up itself.


Your feedback is appreciated and if you do encounter any problems. Please let me know!

notes.title: OS Version - 1.5
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

[b]I have been paying attention to your reviews, it's great to read what you have to say! [/b]

Just a small update for you - 

- All unlocked gallery images will now play a unique audio clip on opening.
- Hack effect added to gallery images.
- Basic animation added to 3 of the gallery images.
- UI scaling bug causing some minor issues with 5:4, 4:3, 3:2 - Fixed
- SFX volume slider added to adjust In-game voices. 
- Volume settings are now also within Hack-Her - Just hit tab.


[b]What's being work on?[/b]

- Additional customization settings.
- Difficulty option for "Hack-her".
- Additional audio prompts. 
- More interactivity between "Hack-Her" and your desktop. 
- More enemy types!

[i]How long before the next update?[/i]
I have already started work on the above mentioned, but i don't currently have an ETA. I will update as soon as it's ready.

Thank you for your support everyone, it great to see all of you uploading your scores to the leaderboard too! 

Any problems with the new update, let me know.
